experiment.title: Five-bit structured-label balanced-universe implementation preflight v3a
experiment.objective: Implement and independently verify the SGCP-EMBED-001 version-3a builder on only the generated five-bit curve, optimizing over every balanced degree-four formal multiset with only forced degree-two closure, before proposing the full 5-12 bit sweep.
controls: PC-FREE-MONOID passes identity, commutativity, associativity, and unique factorization.
PC-CYCLIC-NO-WRAP passes an injective cyclic evaluation before modular wrap.
PC-EC-FOREST exactly accepts the fixed B=8 alternate (1,6,6,6) closure.
PC-REPEATED-PRIME passes unique multiset factorization through exponent four.
NC-DUPLICATE-TAG is rejected by the one-label-per-point gate.
NC-COMPAT-MUTATION changes only EC decoding and fails compatibility while abstract axioms pass.
NC-FINAL-EDGE uses a valid degree-eight order ideal and fails only the direct final-edge boundary.
NC-B6-D2-COLLISION reconstructs the fixed degree-two-versus-singleton collision.
NC-B8-CANONICAL-LOSS reconstructs an invalid canonical and valid alternate witness for one output.
NC-OPTIMIZER-FIXTURE reproduces a frozen unique lexicographic optimum.

primary: exact identity, commutativity, associativity, compatibility, unique-factorization, acyclicity, source, and final-boundary checks
raw and retained final split-support ratio
raw and retained absolute group coverage
secondary: raw and canonical degree-two/four witness counts
star edge density and serialized table bits
candidate-universe digest, exact pruning nodes and full objective proof
separate public-model and charged private-audit bytes
wall time, operation counters, and deep bytes

stopping_rules: Stop if a bound source hash differs or a fixture recount fails.
Stop if builder-visible data contains scalar indices.
Stop if any isolated control behaves contrary to the version-2 contract.
Stop if exhaustive five-bit pruning exceeds the declared run budget.
Do not run any 6-12 bit hypothesis row in this preflight.
invalidation_rules: Builder and verifier import one another or share a scalar table.
Certificate integers are replaced by Boolean or floating-point values.
A direct final A4-by-A4 edge is exposed by a purported valid embedding.
P2 omits a distinct balanced formal degree-four candidate or independently retains a canonical degree-two maximum.
Private optimizer or pair-sum audit material is counted as free public star advice.
The verifier does not reconstruct every certificate row and control.
A five-bit result is interpreted as full-contract evidence or an ECDLP speedup.
experiment.success_criterion: Preflight succeeds only if all five-bit B rows terminate, every isolated positive and negative control behaves as preregistered, the independent verifier exact-compares the public model and charged private audit including exhaustive optimality, and the report remains implementation-only regardless of embedding retention.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Return REVISE if any control, source binding, fixture, exact axiom check, certificate field, or independent reconstruction fails; preserve the smallest mismatch and do not run larger rows.
required_artifacts: independent scalar-index oracle source and frozen artifact
